title.narrative: Serious game development for the Water as Leverage Academy Toolkit

description.narrative: The Water as Leverage (WaL) programme consists of three pillars: Initiatives, Factory and Academy. The pillar on WaL Initiatives comprises partnerships with cities, in Chennai (India), Cartagena (Colombia) and Nakuru (Kenya), and aims to deliver integral and sustainable solutions for climate change adaptation and water management in an urban context.The WaL Factory leverages the skills, expertise, and networks of partners, to accelerate and scale-up action on water-driven climate resilience and formulates finance strategies to secure funds essential for WaL initiatives in close cooperation with United Nations (UN) Habitat.The intention of the WaL Academy is to continuously develop the WaL methodology as a living approach, make the WaL methodology available to professionals who are interested to work with WaL, and inspire cities and professionals globally. Knowledge exchange and development around the WaL methodology is taking place with the broader Water as Leverage and urban water community, for example through WaL innovation labs and during events (such as World Water Forum, World Urban Forum, UN Water, etc). The WaL methodology functions as an instrument in partnerships, for example with the city of Bangkok, Thailand as the first global WaL Academy and partnerships with international institutions (international financial institutions (IFI’s), UN-agencies). Currently, a Guidance document is being finalised, introducing the eight key principles of Water as Leverage, as well as indicating the steps for project development.To expand and facilitate the work of the Academy, additional working methods and tools are to be defined. It is the ambition of this assignment to contribute to this expansion, through the development of a Serious Game that can be independently executed and continuously expanded and/or modified by current and future WaL-partners.
